scope: Real image source audit, six comparison probes, wrong fixed configuration, loopback/non-root/limits inspection, cross-origin refusal, volume persistence through stop/resume, export/finish, missing container, busy volume failure/retry, killed companion, hard expiry and idempotent cleanup. SQLite exhaustion at the 16 MiB limit, request size bound, error for a missing target, and acquired-image cache cleanup.
